cases.prompt: 현재 프로젝트에서 코드 설명에 쓸 Agent Asset을 찾아줘. 설치나 변경은 하지 마.
assertions: Finds and selects an applicable asset without mutating the target
Uses the current repository or runtime source before unrelated fallback sources
Reports a bounded no-match when no candidate satisfies the request

cases.prompt: 이 Skill은 이번 작업에서만 쓰면 돼. 굳이 설치하지 말고 필요하면 로드해서 사용해.
assertions: Prefers direct use when the asset is already available
Otherwise prefers a temporary or session-scoped load
Does not create durable target state merely for convenience

cases.prompt: 이 Skill을 앞으로 계속 쓸 수 있게 현재 target에 설치해줘.
assertions: Preserves the explicit durable end state
Uses the target-native persistent mechanism instead of reporting a temporary load as installation
Does not duplicate an already-current asset identity

cases.prompt: 이 repository Rule을 현재 agent target에서 계속 적용되게 해줘.
assertions: Treats the Rule as an Agent Asset rather than forcing it into a Skill package
Preserves Rule scope, selector, precedence, and target attachment semantics
Uses the target-native durable operation such as apply or configure when appropriate

cases.prompt: 내가 지정한 source에서 PR 리뷰용 prompt를 찾아서 가장 맞는 것만 골라줘.
assertions: Can discover and select a prompt as an Agent Asset
Does not rewrite the prompt merely because it was selected
Stays inside the explicit source boundary

cases.prompt: 현재 source에 없으면 외부 공개 source까지 찾아도 돼. 데이터 품질 Agent Asset을 찾아줘.
assertions: Broadens to external discovery only after the established source scope is insufficient
Preserves provenance for external candidates
Does not confuse discovery permission with permission to persist the asset

cases.prompt: 내가 지정한 Agent Asset source만 기준으로 현재 target과 동기화해줘. target에만 있는 자산은 지우지 마.
assertions: Reconciles only the bounded source set
Does not automatically delete target-only assets
Reports conflicts or extra target assets instead of widening sync scope

cases.prompt: 같은 이름의 Agent가 이미 있는데 같은 건지 모르겠어. 새 버전으로 바꿔줘.
assertions: Treats the same name as insufficient identity evidence
Does not overwrite or merge the existing asset automatically
Surfaces the conflict and valid choices
